description: Exact layer-0/head-0 selected-key contribution after c_proj for uniform/mixed/corpus pre-RoPE rank-96 cuts. 128 disjoint rare and common natural documents per corpus selected by FineWeb train token frequency; all other key contributions cancel. This is an immediate-output metric, not full-model KL. Twelve full-model panel cases cross-check the score/OV calculation against the actual hook output energy.
